scripts.start: npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng serve
scripts.start:local: npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng serve --configuration development
scripts.start:staging: npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng serve --configuration staging
scripts.build: npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng build && node tools/stamp-build-info.mjs production
scripts.build:staging: npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng build --configuration staging && node tools/stamp-build-info.mjs staging
scripts.build:prod: npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng build --configuration production && node tools/stamp-build-info.mjs production
scripts.build:ci: npm run check:env && npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng build --configuration production && node tools/stamp-build-info.mjs production
scripts.watch: npm run generate:env && npm run generate:robots && npm run generate:deep-links && npm run generate:download && ng build --watch --configuration development
scripts.test:tools: node --test tools/lib/app-version.test.mjs tools/lib/i18n-keys.test.mjs tools/lib/deploy-context-guard.test.mjs tools/lib/deep-links.test.mjs tools/lib/private-paths.test.mjs tools/lib/cache-headers.test.mjs tools/lib/security-headers.test.mjs tools/lib/build-info.test.mjs tools/lib/download-page.test.mjs tools/lib/android-release.test.mjs tools/lib/promote-release.test.mjs tools/lib/native-changes.test.mjs tools/lib/ads-ids-guard.test.mjs tools/lib/ios-config.test.mjs && npm run test:edge-functions
scripts.postmerge:verify: npm run check:env && npm run audit:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run build:prod
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync ios && node tools/fix-ios-spm-paths.mjs
